title: Blocky GUI
description: New look of default minecraft GUI
body:
---

About

This is a vanilla-friendly resource pack adding a new & fresh interface replacement for established classic Minecraft GUI

Main Features & Style

Pack adds textures for almost all currently exist containers, mounts and main menu buttons with unique style: flat & sharp design; edges highlight; 'immersive' effect and etc.
---

Pack Contain

---

Reworked GUI

  • Inventory
  • Creative Inventory
  • Containers
  • Main Menu
  • Gamemode Changer Menu (F3 + F4)
  • Tabs

Reworked HUD

  • Hotbar
  • Hearts & Hunger Bar
  • Experience Bar

Tweaks

  • Villagers Trading Menu
  • Trapped Chest
---
